title: molpathR: Molecular pathology data platform for clinical NGS integration
description: molpathR brings together molecular pathology data from sources that normally live apart, including next-generation sequencing files, XML variant interpretation reports, structured pathology PDF reports, pathology and clinical information systems, and survival outcome data. It links these records into a searchable in-memory database so that variant, report and outcome information for a case can be queried as one dataset. An interactive application supports clinical exploration and cohort-level analysis over the linked data. It is intended for molecular pathology and clinical genomics groups that need an integrated view across heterogeneous diagnostic outputs.
